headline: Asian Market Today: Mixed Trading in Asian Markets, Softer Bond Yields, Nikkei and Kospi Gain
summary: Asian markets traded mixed on Wednesday after overnight gains on Wall Street. Falling crude oil prices and declining bond yields supported the Nikkei and Kospi.
why: The Nikkei 225 and Kospi are the benchmark stock indexes of Japan and South Korea, two major Asian economies. Oil and bond yields feed into equity valuations and inflation expectations across the region.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index gained in the same session.
